title: Command Phases & Deterministic Order Resolution
objective: Implement deterministic command-phase coordination over visible SCL-03 order intent while preserving canonical Action/Combat/Event execution authority and preventing duplicate effects.

tranche_context.expansion_rule: No context expansion unless a named source is missing or contradictory, changed validation evidence identifies a concrete dependency, canonical authority drifts, or the owner explicitly requests expansion.

resolved_contract.eligibility_rule: Only visible SCL-03 orders with resolved evidence, lifecycle received, resolved command/delegation scope and non-interrupted communication may become handoff candidates. Proposed, issued and acknowledged orders remain blocked pending receipt. Superseded and cancelled orders are inactive-invalid.
resolved_contract.precedence_rule: No order-type priority hierarchy exists. Precedence is accepted only from explicit visible dependency, supersession and conflict references. Missing referenced orders block; dependency cycles or unresolved explicit conflicts produce conflict. Independent eligible orders are sorted by stable order id only for deterministic receipt/handoff ordering, never as command authority.
resolved_contract.simultaneous_rule: Explicitly conflicting simultaneous orders never auto-select a winner. They remain conflict unless visible supersession resolves the relationship. Independent simultaneous orders may produce separate handoff requests.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: SCL-04 resolves command-order coordination only. It classifies an order ready, partial, blocked, invalid or conflict and produces zero or more owner-domain handoff requests. It never executes an Action, applies Combat, creates an Event outcome, advances time or mutates canonical owner state.
resolved_contract.partial_rule: An otherwise eligible order is partial only when at least one visible owner-domain handoff is resolved and at least one other visible handoff is unknown, conflict, incompatible or blocked. No hidden handoff may affect visible status or counts.
resolved_contract.handoff_rule: Every ready handoff names exactly one canonical owner domain from action, combat or event plus explicit owner/provenance references. Downstream domains decide and commit canonical results; SCL-04 receipts cannot be replayed as world-state truth and may not double-apply downstream effects.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before order inclusion, dependencies, precedence, conflict grouping, outcomes, handoff counts, summaries, search, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden existence and cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, unknown, conflict or incompatible visible evidence remains conservative and cannot be guessed, auto-reconciled or promoted to ready.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: Stable order id, explicit dependency/supersession/conflict ids and owner-domain handoff ids define deterministic receipt order. Presentation prose is excluded from receipt truth.
resolved_contract.ai_rule: AI may advise only where separately governed. SCL-04 invokes no provider and grants no command, decision, adjudication, permission, mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-04 ledger or migration. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

acceptance_contract.red_rule: Acceptance/proof/profile/verifier land before production contract/panel and fail at intended missing production imports after invariants/install pass on both self-hosted lanes.
acceptance_contract.green_rule: Exactly one SCL-04 current-family profile passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison with zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: Ordinary Action/Combat/Event and canonical owner-domain state remain authoritative.
SCL-04 creates deterministic coordination and handoff projection only; no downstream morale/logistics/fleet/casualty/consequence mechanic is implemented.
No owner mutation, AI command/adjudication, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-05+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Validate and merge this governed start, then establish genuine SCL-04 cross-platform acceptance-first RED before production mutation.
